caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned upright in the center of the page, against a light beige background. The object appears to be a metal stand or frame with a vertical rod as its main axis. At the top of the rod, there is a rounded, spherical element colored yellow. Below this, there are several curved metal arms extending outward and downward, some with curled or spiral ends. Two of the arms curve horizontally at different heights, and one arm extends upward with a short, outward curve at its end. The central vertical rod continues downward, bisecting a rectangular support structure formed by more curved metal rods that loop at the corners. The base of the object has three legs, each curving outward and downward, providing balance to the stand. The stand’s color is primarily a brownish metallic tone, with shading that suggests a three-dimensional form. The composition is simple, with the object centrally placed and ample empty space surrounding it.
